0022600103.text: Neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet, so both records stand at 0-0 for the season. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (ruptured Achilles), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Malik Monk (ankle soreness), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while Portland is without Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The Kings lost 0-4 to the Trail Blazers in the 2025-26 season, including a 122-110 defeat in Portland on April 12, 2026.
